name: nolane-video-command-center
description: The single AI-first front door for Nolane video production. Bundles 28 integrated skills for story, cinematography, motion, 3D/VFX, Manim, AI media, audio/speech, editorial, toolchain automation, licensing and evidence-based QA.

interface.longDescription: One private entry point with 28 internal skills for end-to-end video direction, story, cinematography, Remotion/HyperFrames, Manim, 3D/VFX, AI media planning, ComfyUI, browser capture, audio/speech, bilingual caption QA, editorial interchange, CI, licensing and production review. Routes across the CPU-first Nolane-x/video toolchain and protects the separate resource-library workstream.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create, continue or improve my video using Nolane Video Command Center. Select the smallest effective set of internal skills and tools, work in a clean dedicated GitHub branch, preserve the parallel asset workstream, render candidates and verify technical plus visual quality before delivery.
